then.text: The caves behind Norman Island. Good luck. Mind the snorkellers.

else.text: Third clue? Go to Norman Island, the south islet. There's a treasure hunter sat on a rock who's been there three years. He knows the spot.
Find the crab in the Baths first. He's got the next clue. Don't ask. He tells everyone.
The Rhone: a Royal Mail steamer, sunk 29 October 1867 in a hurricane. Two halves, bow and stern, and one of the best dives anywhere. The film The Deep was shot partly here.
Please don't take anything from the wreck. Not even a bolt. We know who you are.
